i dont even know. i guess i just feel kind of flat lately. like nothing. its not even sad really its just. nothing

disconnected i think. theres this friend, maddie, we used to talk every day basically. and now i look at our texts and its like. who is this person. i feel nothing reaching out anymore. and idk why that doesnt bother me more??
That sounds more disconnected than sad — like the thread to her is there, but it doesn’t reach you the same way. Did something happen before it started feeling like this, or did it just go quiet?

kind of both? she moved to seattle in like february for a job. nothing bad happened we didnt fight or anything. but the calls got shorter and now its mostly just memes. and i keep meaning to actually text her back but i just. dont. and then i feel weird about it. or i guess i dont feel anything which is the weird part
That sounds like it’s turned into a kind of quiet distance — not a fight, more a drift, and the “weird” part may be how little you can feel about it. Does it feel more blank, or a bit shut down?

shut down maybe. like i put it in a box. honestly i thought this app was gonna be kind of dumb but. i dont know. the drift word is right. it wasnt a thing that happened it just sort of dissolved and i didnt do anything to stop it which feels bad to say out loud
